gameVerifiedNote: Interop metadata from the Forge-MapEditor-QA profile, dump.cs of the same build and a read-only x64 decode of GameAssembly.dll. No method was invoked, no hook was installed and no game was started, so every claim below is about the compiled body, not about a running session.
scope: The player health receiver ForgeMap commits through: PlayerAgent.Damage, the Dam_PlayerDamageBase hierarchy, the one absolute-health write entry, and what the receive path refuses. The reads the adapter performs are registered in evidence/map-hooks.json (player-agent-damage, player-health, player-health-max, player-health-setup, player-damage-owner, player-agent-alive); this document is the write entry's own evidence and the semantics the action layer stands on.

writeEntries.inherited: Dam_PlayerDamageBase (dump.cs 544830) declares no SendSetHealth, SendLocally or SendPacket of its own; the player class carries ReceiveSetHealth, ReceiveAddHealth and OnRevive overrides only, so the one write entry is the base declaration.

body.hostGate: `mov rax,[SNet]; mov rax,[rax+0B8h]; cmp byte ptr [rax+0B9h],0` at +0x97..+0xA5; a zero master flag branches to the reporting path at RVA 0x161F899, which calls 0x1DDC1F0 and returns without applying anything.
body.quantize: the master path encodes the submitted value against HealthMax (`movss xmm2,[this+1Ch]`, `call 0x181BB5B00`) into a 16-bit field, so the value the receiver stores is a quantization of the submitted one.
body.submit: the encoded value is sent through 0x181633510 and then handed to the receiver's own virtual receive through the class method pair at +0x3C0 (slot 41, `ReceiveSetHealth`) on the same machine.
body.meaning: one entry both replicates and applies: the host quantizes, broadcasts the packet and applies locally; a client that reached it would only take the reporting branch.

writeEntries.body: host-gated the same way; decodes the packet's delta against HealthMax (`call 0x181BB5AE0`), adds the receiver's current health, clamps the sum against HealthMax (`call 0x180F01680`), stores it and then calls Dam_SyncedDamageBase::SendSetHealth with the absolute result.
writeEntries.meaning: the game's own heal path is a delta wrapper that ends in the same absolute write entry, which is why the action layer declares no second entry: submitting the absolute value through SendSetHealth is what the game does after its own clamp.

playerReceiveSetHealth.body: reads the receiver's Owner (field +0xF0); a null owner returns without storing. Otherwise it calls the owner's virtual slot 11 (`PlayerAgent::get_Alive`, RVA 0xCAD190, a byte read at +0xD0 of the agent) and a false answer returns without storing. Only then does it decode the 16-bit value against HealthMax (`call 0x181BB5AE0`) and store it at +0x20, followed by its own state notifications.
playerReceiveSetHealth.meaning: a dead player cannot be written to, and a receiver without an owner cannot either. The player domain's `not-alive` refusal is this same condition checked before anything is submitted, and no health write can revive: reviving is the separate OnRevive flow (RVA 0x1617230, slot 66), which this adapter never calls.

setup.body: writes Health = HealthMax, sets IsSetup (+0x24) to 1, stores the agent in Owner (+0xF0) and writes m_onlyToMaster (+0x25) as (DamageBaseOwner == 1); it then reads HealthMax from the agent's own data.
setup.meaning: an un-set-up receiver holds no meaningful health state, which is why the adapter refuses one instead of reading it.

facts.claim: A player's absolute health has exactly one write entry, Dam_SyncedDamageBase.SendSetHealth, shared with the game's own heal path.
facts.basis: Dam_PlayerDamageBase declares no writer; ReceiveAddHealth clamps and calls that entry

facts.claim: The entry applies nothing on a client.
facts.basis: the master-flag branch in its own body; the branch target only reports

facts.claim: A dead player's health is never stored by the receive path.
facts.basis: the Owner.Alive guard in the player's ReceiveSetHealth override

facts.claim: A downed player is a legal recipient in this model.
facts.basis: PlayerAgent.Alive stays true while PlayerLocomotion reports Downed (evidence/player-observation.json); the receive path consults Alive alone

facts.claim: The committed amount is the receiver's readback, never the requested amount.
facts.basis: the entry quantizes against HealthMax and applies through the receiver's own virtual call, so the stored value can differ from the submitted one

facts.claim: Committing health does not revive anyone.
facts.basis: the write path stores a value and notifies; reviving is Dam_PlayerDamageBase.OnRevive, a different flow this adapter never calls

unverified.question: Whether the quantized value actually lands and how a live session's readback settles after the packet round-trip.
unverified.why: no game execution and no host/client pair; the adapter therefore reports only what its own readback shows and never the requested amount

unverified.question: How the set-health channel behaves for a client that joins after the write.
unverified.why: the packet is the game's own; no session was observed

unverified.question: Whether a health write to a downed player also moves the locomotion machine.
unverified.why: the receive path stores health and runs its own notifications; whether the downed state reacts to the value is not established, and the action layer does not claim it

unverified.question: Which native healer tools call ReceiveAddHealth versus another path.
unverified.why: only the two entries' bodies were decoded; the callers of ReceiveAddHealth were not enumerated

gameVerificationPlan: In an installed profile, heal a player at low health and confirm the result row's amount matches the health delta shown by the game.
Heal a dead player and confirm the command is rejected with `not-alive` and no health changes.
Heal a downed player and confirm health changes while the downed state itself is untouched.
Heal from a client and confirm the command is rejected with `authority-or-phase` and nothing is applied.
limits: No native invocation, no game execution, no multiplayer and no host/client pair was exercised
The decode proves instruction shapes at the frozen RVAs of this build; the RVA-to-method binding comes from dump.cs of the same build
The action layer's result rows and refusal codes are covered by the managed tests, not by this document
